simple.meaning: Dishon , the name of two Edomites
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דִּישׁוֹן (H1787) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דִּישׁוֹן (Dîyshôwn) means Dishon , the name of two Edomites First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 38.

definitions.short: Dishon , the name of two Edomites
definitions.full: H1787. Dishon II. דִּישֹׁן proper name, masculine 1. a son of Seir דִּשׁוֺן Gen 36:21 = דִּישֹׁן 1Chr 1:38 ; 2 a son of Anah & grandson of Seir דִּשֹׁ֑ן Gen 36:25 compare 36:30 so also 36:26 (for דִּישָׁן q. v.) = דִּישׁוֺן 1Chr 1:41 (twice in verse); 1:42 , compare also following
